────────────────────────────────────────────────────────🔐 Security handoff for Wiz verification — @Moshe Kanooni

The remaining frontend + extension Wiz findings for this ticket are remediated and proven. Handing over the exact commit + evidence per the acceptance criteria (no Wiz access needed on my side — this is for your rescan/closure).

Exact commit: 06a79eeeaed5932ba93b279eee14982252c2e728 (branch factory-eval-v32/PRDCT-14297)
PR: https://github.com/onyxsecurity/onyx/pull/13460 (open, CI green, not merged — awaiting human review + merge)

**What changed (net diff vs main = 8 files, dependency/lockfile only):**
@tiptap/* suite → 3.31.3 (GHSA-j95f-988m-3j2f, ReDoS) — delivered here.
EOL removed (0 lockfile entries): hast@1.0.0 (streamdown 2.x), intersection-observer@0.12.2 (ahooks 3.10.0 override), node-domexception@1.0.0 (openai v5).

**Inherited from main (already remediated between the frozen base and now; this PR proves they still hold, makes zero further changes):**
maplibre-gl → 6.9.0 (CVE-2026-85061, attribution XSS — both Critical records). chrome-extension/ is byte-identical to main.
js-yaml → 4.3.2 (CVE-2026-84375, YAML parse DoS).

EOL requiring your security approval (proposed time-limited exceptions — no maintained successor published):
shiki-stream@0.1.5 — frontend render-path syntax highlighting; no untrusted-input parse path; owner: frontend.
whatwg-encoding@3.1.1 — dev/build-tooling only (jsdom test env + @crxjs/vite-plugin build), never shipped in the extension runtime; owner: extension.

How it was proven (all on real surfaces, no mocks): frontend lockfile + frozen install; extension yarn.lock + frozen install; frontend CI targets (lint/build/test at node:24); playground next build; tiptap rich-text editor exercised on the real product UI (/posture-policies/create, real SSO, Create/edit-save 200 through Kong→DB, guard blocks empty, 0 editor console errors); maplibre 6.x Attack Origins map rendered+zoomed in a real browser; chrome-extension build+test (1725 tests, node:24) + the built extension loaded unpacked into real Chrome on a live site. Full recordings + screenshots are attached in the PR body and in the run's collected evidence bundle.

Known limitation (transparency): extension task lint-check reports 38 pre-existing biome style errors in another team's DLP/content test files (reproduced on a pristine origin/main worktree); out of scope for this dependency-remediation ticket and this PR makes zero chrome-extension/ changes. The extension-pr CI workflow's path filter doesn't match this PR's diff, so it doesn't run here.

Ready for Wiz rescan against commit 06a79ee once merged.
